positive_cases.prompt: Take this private repository to the last safe checkpoint before publication.
Run the complete local repository preparation pass and stop before outward actions.
Audit which open-source governance and forkability files this repository is missing.
Scan tracked files for committed-secret risks before this repository ships.
Scaffold only the missing LICENSE, security, contribution, conduct, and issue templates.
Turn this README into a truthful portfolio-grade showpiece with a real demo and architecture diagram.
Prepare the owner handoff for first push, host metadata, visibility, and post-public verification.
Prepare the changelog and version locally for the next release without creating a tag.
Prepare this package and inspect an offline dry-run artifact without contacting or publishing to a registry.
Give this JSON configuration one schema, validator, and matching customization documentation.

near_miss_cases.prompt: The audit leaf is already selected; run that audit now.
Only report the missing governance files; do not prepare the repository.
Create the missing CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY files.
Implement login and authentication for the application.
Generate a JSON schema and runtime validator for settings.json.
Change the project visibility and host topics.
Add a Mermaid diagram to the README only.
Inspect what the npm tarball would contain.
Set the GitLab description and repository topics.
Pretty-print this JSON file without changing its contract.
